scope: Fresh-process offline Linux AArch64 fixed authored DSO provenance; no generated target invocation

ra-host-substitute.safety: Control refuses before install; no target/replacement call, invalid pointers, data races or frees. Binding-argument checks use raw entry arguments even on refusal.

omit-entry-owner-veto.safety: Dry decision ends before entry/init/install for both variants; no foreign code invocation.

ignore-consumed-query-failure.safety: Dry decision ends before publication or entry, no bad-handle API call. This is injected consumption failure, not observed dlinfo failure.

omit-constructor-marker.safety: No constructor capability or loader behavior changed; control diagnoses missing observation, not constructor prevention.

omit-authoritative-handle-record.safety: No dlclose, unload or stale read. Only bookkeeping-loss discrimination; safety hold must be declared and cannot be counted as authoritative receipt. Descriptor continuation uses only that declared safety hold for fixture access; an empty authoritative record must not add a lifecycle veto and cascade other failures.

limitations: No patched target/replacement dispatch exists in the authored harness; target_invocations=0 describes that bounded action surface, not instruction tracing.
All handles are retained permanently; the custody control keeps a separate explicit safety hold.
Raw builtin RA and actual libc query outcomes are separate from consumed control values.
No manifest/approval parser, arbitrary DSO or production loader.
No previous scalar, ABI, exception, CFI or policy suite is executed.
